title: Army transfer rejects all selected units instead of partially moving those that fit
body:
Residual discrepancy from closed umbrella [#802](https://github.com/diegoami/imperial_conquest_2/issues/802), isolated during the owner-requested restrictions audit. The umbrella's comments already record increasingly strong evidence; closing it did not remove this implementation behavior. [#869](https://github.com/diegoami/imperial_conquest_2/issues/869) concerns landing/iteration order, not atomic refusal.

[ArmyTransferCommandHandler.cs:125–146](https://github.com/diegoami/imperial_conquest_2/blob/4d70275aac4e155c0370a3ee23525cf34450a908/src/IC2.Engine/Armies/Commands/ArmyTransferCommandHandler.cs#L125) computes the final combined selection, then rejects the whole order for >20 units, >100000 troops or fleet capacity. ArmyDialogModels stages the selection and submits one combined order, so the GUI reaches this behavior.

The [20-unit transfer report](https://github.com/diegoami/imperial-conquest-2-research/blob/865755e04f107afc38cdb496669d882e2551aca6/docs/reports/2026-10-08-transfer-dialog-20-units-and-slot-gaps.md) records a target18 plus selected3: the two highest selected slots move, the lowest stays, one box follows; Cancel commits nothing. The later [supply/transfer report §3](https://github.com/diegoami/imperial-conquest-2-research/blob/865755e04f107afc38cdb496669d882e2551aca6/docs/reports/2026-10-09-supply-providers-and-transfer-clamps.md) measures troop/fleet clamps similarly: each selected unit is tested, fitting units move, others stay. These are bounded original Wine observations plus code evidence, not new native Windows runs.

Native production dispatcher probe at released4d70275a, shipped classical-faithful rules over public synthetic toy-state entities: donor3 units, receiver19, select2 donor units. Result rejected=True, code armies.army-transfer-units-too-large, receiver remains19. The two selected units would permit one move before hitting20 under the reported original policy. Probe exit0. No original/private inputs used.

Triage: correction needs a bounded contract covering working copies, per-unit admission/order, one refusal summary, real-slot identities, two directions, resource staging/OK/Cancel, moves and carrier links. Preserve 20-unit/100000 limits themselves. The exact fleet integer boundary is filed separately so a single-unit case can independently discriminate it. Do not widen into owner-approved fleet-to-fleet safety exceptions (#1340). No implementation performed.
